citation: Bowen v. City of New York, 476 U.S. 467 (1986)
court: Supreme Court of the United States
rule_established: §405(g) 60-day deadline equitably tolled where SSA conceals material information affecting claimant's ability to challenge denial; government cannot benefit from own concealment; class action available for systematic violations
direct_application: Phantom contact records (9/18/2019, 3/23/2020, 12/17/2020) = SSA false records concealing basis for disability claim interference; equitable tolling applies from date of discovery of phantom contacts
